name: English Honours
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

requirements.title: Students complete 120 units, as specified below
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Completion of ENGL 364 is required prior to admission to the honours program.

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students proposing to enter the honours program will complete the same lower division ENGL courses as English majors (see below).

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Normally a 3.5 GPA in all Simon Fraser University English courses and a CGPA of 3.0 are required for acceptance and continuance.

requirements.title: Students complete any two 100-division English courses
requirements.note: Such courses may include: ENGL 111W, ENGL 112W, ENGL 113W, ENGL 114W, ENGL 115W, ENGL 199W

requirements.title: Students also complete any four 200-division English courses
requirements.note: Such courses may include: ENGL 202, ENGL 204, ENGL 209, ENGL 210, ENGL 211, ENGL 213, ENGL 214 and 3 more

sections.note: Students wishing to major in English are strongly advised to submit a formal declaration to this effect to the undergraduate advisor upon completing all lower division requirements.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: English honours students must obtain 48 upper division ENGL units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of 20 of these units must be at the 400-level, excluding Directed Studies Courses (ENGL 490, 491).

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of four units must be from the following group of courses, focused on Canadian and/or Indigenous Literature.
